Relevant threat entries: TB-013/T-061 (CLI downloads and runs the sandbox installer and add-on as the Mac owner; not retained in the supplied index excerpt beyond headers) and TB-012/A-018 (add-on hold). Documentation does not alter controls: installer is still fetched over HTTPS, run via /bin/sh from a 0600 file in a 0700 dir, not verified beyond TLS by the CLI, with the add-on verifying its release itself; this is pre-existing and consistent with T-061. No retained cache (T-041) or logout (A-008/T-053) text changed in the visible ranges. Remaining integration questions: confirm the Swift implementation of --disk validation and passing to the installer (no shell interpolation, absolute path normalization, option injection), and whether the threat model for TB-013 should mention work disks on external volumes holding VM images/job data (outside the attested boundary). No concrete security regression is evidenced by the supplied text.
